Convert a 3D Segmentation Mask (dicom_seg) to RTSTRUCT Contours

Source: R/rt-struct.R
seg_to_rtstruct.Rd

Traces closed 2D planar polygon contours slice-by-slice from a dicom_seg mask and transforms pixel indices to LPS world coordinates using ref_volume$affine, producing an RTSTRUCT object (see read_dicom_rt()).

Usage

seg_to_rtstruct(seg, ref_volume, roi_name = NULL, roi_color = "255\\0\\0")

Arguments

seg

A dicom_seg object.

ref_volume

Reference dicom_volume providing spatial geometry.

roi_name

Name for the exported ROI (defaults to segment label).

roi_color

Color string (e.g. "255\\0\\0").

Value

A dicom_rt object of modality "RTSTRUCT".

Examples

synth <- dicom_synthesize(modality = "CT", dims = c(32L, 32L, 5L))
vol <- read_dicom_volume(synth[["out_dir"]])
m <- array(0L, dim = c(32L, 32L, 5L))
m[5:15, 5:15, 2:3] <- 1L
seg <- dicom_seg(m, vol)
rt <- seg_to_rtstruct(seg, vol)
rt$modality
#> [1] "RTSTRUCT"
